mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image, p.price, p.stock FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image, p.price, p.stock FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
